notes.title: Guardians of the Past - Update 1.2.1
notes.notes:
We're here again with some more bug fixes.

Fixed a bug which stopped Market and Docks from being selected when randomising the map.
Fixed a bug in local play which showed the BOTS placeable traps as grey boxes.
Fixed a bug in local play which showed the BOTS slot machines as empty. Now completely hidden.
Fixed a major bug which stopped BOTS from conforming completely to physics, BOTS now get launched into the pit as easy as you do.
BOTS will now randomly walk in different directions when under the effects of the confusion debuff.
BOTS are now more decisive when picking up and using items. (No more dropping and picking up an item before using it.)
BOTS are now less likely to get stuck when pathing to players and other BOTS.
BOTS now disregard targeting other enemies when they are considered off the playable area.
Adjusted the navigation area on the Docks and Island maps.
Local play now correctly shows the input device controls for player 1.
Hiding controls in the settings now hides the popup when standing next to a gadget.

If you encounter any bugs or issues please help spread the word in the various respective steam forums or come and visit our discord server!

notes.title: Guardians of the Past - Major Update 1.2 - THE BATTLE OF THE BOTS!
notes.notes:
Recently, we've been busy with looking at how we can improve Guardians Of The Past and one of the biggest requests that we had while developing it, was that people wanted the ability to play against AI-controlled BOTS! And although it's been a long time in the making, we can confirm that we've done just that! It's been a big task but we have now implemented AI BOTS into all game modes and game types both locally and online! Fill up the empty slots in your lobbies or add one to your team in team mode for that handicap edge over your skilled friends! We have more things planned for Guardians so stay tuned!



--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[b]Below is a short but sweet list of significant changes that come with the update![/b]


- Added bots to the game.
- Added some music to the Trapopedia and the Lobby.
- Added the ability to change the number of bots that get added.
- Fixed a visual bug in the lobby.

If you encounter any bugs or issues please help spread the word in the various respective steam forums or come and visit our discord server!

notes.title: Guardians Of The Past - 1.1 Update - Achievements!
notes.notes:
Hey Guardians,

You may have noticed the over the last few days the new addition of achievements. There are 12 currently with the possibility of more being added in the future. We think they are suitably challenging but easily accomplished over time. 

To enable these achievements, we've pushed an update with a couple of minor changes too.

[list]
[*] Enabled Achievements.
[*] Changed the default gadget difficulty to Advanced in online sessions.
[*] Added in a new default taskbar icon.
[*] Reduced the cooldown of the hammer by 50%. 
[*] Reduced the damage of the hammer by 25%.
[/list]

As usual, if you have any questions, bugs or suggestions, feel free to let us know on our community hub or in our discord.

notes.title: Guardians Of The Past - 1.0 - Full Release
notes.notes:
It's been nearly 8 months since we launched in Early Access, and after numerous updates, we are finally happy to call Guardians Feature Complete. Its been a long and enjoyable road and we couldn't have done it without our early backers. 

[h1][b]View the release trailer below![/b][/h1]

https://youtu.be/DOktZKLok88

As we move onto other projects that are in the pipeline, feel free to continue telling us about any bugs through our discord or in our community hub.

[h1]The full release will include:-[/h1]
[list]
[*] 6 different maps with unique hazards.
[*] 4 game modes.
[*] 2 characters with colour customisation.
[*] 9 gadgets.
[*] 15 traps.
[*] Various settings and customisation for tournaments.
[/list]

[h1][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

[list]
[h1]Key Features[/h1]
[*]Added new map called The Market.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32936734/a24ff2d21583a1ac50ab1b650415706dca151283.png[/img]
Battle your friends in The Market, as angry merchants and civilians hurl food your way.

[*]Added new map called The Docks.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32936734/38b702526027607434857e78075825e2b5ae5db3.png[/img]
Take the fight to The Dock and use the floating barrels to spring yourself to victory. 

[*]Added in 2 new game modes - Team Classic and Team Brawl.
[*]Added in cinematics to improve transitions between different phases of the game.
[*]Added music for each map.
[*]Added the ability to change the gadget difficulty in lobbies.
[*]Optimised each map to reduce the workload on GPUs, which should vastly improve performance.
[*]More optimisation for the network to help reduce lag.

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[*]Removed the laser indicator from the minigun.
[*]Fixed a bug with the hammer which sometimes reset its cooldown if used at the wrong time.
[*]Added the ability for mouse and keyboard players to left click to fire in any direction without aiming.
[*]Dart trap no longer affects players in the grace period.

[h1]UI[/h1]
[*]Added a credits screen.
[*]Fixed selection arrows not correctly hiding when readying up.
[*]Fixed a bug in local play which allowed players to edit another players colour.
[*]Fixed a bug in local play which stopped Captain Finley from showing up when selected in local play.
[*]Improved the Map Select screens navigation and selection.
[*]Fixed a bug which caused music to be played when hit by the red jouster. (Not sure how that got in there).
[*]Updated the UI to allow for the new team game modes.
[*]Massively improved the performance inside the Library.
[*]Added Captain Finley's face for use in the necessary UIs.
[*]Updated the Map Select screen to allow for the 2 new maps.
[*]Added a ready indicator during the multiplayer picking phase.
[*]Updated the loading screens to account for the new maps and game modes.
[*]Updated the waiting screen to be more consistent with the rest of the UI.
[*]Added drop shadows to certain white text to make it easier to see.
[*]Added various UI elements for more flavour during the cinematics.
[*]Fixed a bug which stopped the UI from being removed at the end of a local play round.
[*]Updated the visuals of the lobby screen settings for all players.
[*]Added in lots of UI sounds for moving between buttons and menus.
[*]Updated the leaderboard screen to work with team modes.

[/list]

notes.title: Update Alpha 3.0! - Miniguns, Library And More!
notes.notes:
Hey Guardians! This update brings a whole batch of new features and fixes along with some groundwork for future features and mechanics coming soon!

[h1]--------------------------[/h1]
[h1]STEAM DEMO![/h1]
Over the past few weeks we have been working on a Steam Demo! This will allow players to get a feel for a more simple version of the game with limited features. The idea of this is to allow you guys to experience a small part of the game to help you decide if it's your cup of tea! Which we're already pretty sure it is, who doesn't like an arena full of your friends surrounded by gunfire, flames, traps and explosions??

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32936734/94a43e1f5de613028b949a5108a4505eb2f09302.png[/img]
Be sure to give it a try and tell us what you think on our community forums or on any of our social medias!

[h1]--------------------------[/h1]
[h1]THE MINIGUN![/h1]
We have implemented a new Gadget called The Minigun! It is a heavy, long ranged weapon that shoots rapid projectiles at your foes!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32936734/da6a0604eea9f3d222aa52295eec2957c8371319.png[/img]
[list]
    [*]Added a new item - Minigun.
    [*]Has a built-in cooldown that triggers when the gun gets too hot from long term use "Self BBQ Anyone?!"
    [*]Strong at medium range
    [*]Knocks the player back when firing!
    [*]Very heavy!
[/list]

[h1]--------------------------[/h1]
[h1]THE LIBRARY![/h1]
We have implemented a new section for all the statistical gamers that like to see how things work. The Library! Accessable from the main menu is a feature that lets you look at all the Traps, Items and Gamemodes avaliable and also a How To Play section with controls as well as tips and tricks to get that edge over the casual players!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32936734/973584a700ba5a48549128a3fb1ee83ebff9c8cd.png[/img]
[list]
    [*]Added library - Contains information and videos about traps and items, as well as a How to play section.
[/list]

[h1]--------------------------[/h1]
[u][h1]OTHER PATCH NOTES![/h1][/u]
[b][u]UI[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Added an animation to the Item Pickup Decal (Grow and shrink when picked up and dropped)
[*]Added animations to and re-skinned the Picking Phase to be cleaner.
[*]Fixed a bug which allowed other local players to add maps to the playlist.
[*]Fixed a bug with Item Decals not showing their pickup decal after they are dropped.
[*]Fixed a bug with the scoreboard if all players die in a tiebreaker.
[*]Fixed a controller issue with the in-game menu on local play.
[*]Fixed a visual bug with the HUD in local play.
[*]Fixed a visual bug with the map select screen.
[*]Fixed and Tweaked an issue with item pickup decals not correctly hiding and showing when being picked up and dropped
[*]Fixed the Item Cooldown decal being off center of the player causing rotational misalignment
[*]Tweaked the Item pickup Decals to be a little higher stopping them from clipping with the mesh of the item.
[/list]

[b][u]TRAPS[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Added a damage bonus to The Scorcher when its applied to a player that is standing in The Sticker.
[*]Added the ability for traps to be destroyed in preperation for future gamemodes.
[*]Added the ability for traps to undo their effects when destroyed for future gamemodes.
[*]Changed the slow of The Igniter (40%).
[*]Changed the slow of The Sticker (70%).
[*]Improved the physics of The Boomer trap in online play.
[*]The Boomer Bomb is now effected by The Springer, The Jabber and The Bludgeoner.
[/list]

[b][u]ITEMS[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Added a new item - Minigun.
[*]Added an outline back to the grenade launcher.
[*]Fixed a bug which stopped the aim decals from updating when an item despawns.
[*]Fixed the Grenade Launcher blocking the Harpoon projectile.
[*]Harpoon can now pull The Boomer Bomb.
[/list]

[b][u]ARENAS[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a Collision issue with the arena wall in The Pit map.
[/list]

[b][u]GENERAL[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Added a AFK video to the main menu if no input is recieved for 60 seconds.
[*]Improved the transition speed to Build Phase which should stop the droids from not assigning a colour.
[*]Tweaked the camera to now show players spawning in rather than panning to them post spawn.
[*]Tweaked the camera to work better at keeping all players in view at all times.
[*]Added library - Contains information and videos about traps and items, as well as a How to play section.
[/list]

notes.title: Alpha 2.2 Patch Notes

notes.title: Early Access 2.0 Release 30th July!
notes.notes:
[h1] We're releasing in Early Access![/h1]

That's right! We are happy to announce that [b] Guardians of the Past [/b] will soon enter Early Access Alpha 2.0 and go on sale on the 30th of JULY!

We can't wait for you guys to get your hands on a copy and join in the madness, be sure to let us know what you think on our forums or on our discord!

Also, we may as well announce on here since its all over our social media...

[h1]We're going to i63![/h1]

That's right, if your planning on going too be sure to come and drop by the indie section for a brawl with your buddies, or even take on the devs! We're there from the [b]  24th - 27th of AUGUST at the ~ NEC in Birmingham UK! [/b] ALL WEEKEND!

We had so much fun at i62 and just couldn't stay away and hopefully, it's an annual thing! 

Thanks for the support everyone!
             [b]TEAM SQUIDPUNCH[/b]
